verdict.rationale: Weave's own built-in signals automatically classify agent interactions and surface failure modes inside the product, which is a thin form of in-product insight. The docs do not say these insights are AI-generated, and they mention no suggestions or in-product assistant. The MCP server and Skills let external coding agents answer questions about Weave data, but that happens outside the product and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit in-product AI assistant or natural-language Q&A over data, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, explicit documentation that signals are AI/LLM-generated insights, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions, so you always know how your agents are behaving.
out-of-the-box signals to surface failure modes
